run_mae_pretraining: run MAE pre-training on AudioSet with configurable masking ratio and batch size
run_audio_pretraining: run audio MAE pre-training on audioset, esc50, or speechcommands datasets
run_distributed_training: run distributed MAE pre-training across multiple GPUs with gradient accumulation
run_resume_training: resume MAE pre-training from a saved checkpoint at a specific epoch
run_visual_pretraining: run MAE pre-training on ImageNet with random resized crop and horizontal flip augmentation
